# Soulo website context

Updated: 2026-11-11
Canonical website: https://soulo.dkluge.com/

## What is Soulo?

Soulo is an iPhone multi-platform search browser for iOS 17.0 or later. Enter a query once, then switch between 40+ search engines, video platforms, communities and third-party AI services. Those platforms provide their own results; Soulo does not generate or merge answers.

The app includes ad blocking (with rule subscriptions and manual element picker), BT & resource download management (magnet links, `.torrent` files, file selection, pause/resume, and Web Resources for identifying and saving web media, images, and documents), enhanced video & audio playback (HLS streams, playback speed, long-press speed-up, floating window, Picture-in-Picture, background audio, AirPlay, frame capture), eBook & reader mode (auto next-page article extraction plus EPUB, PDF, TXT, MOBI, AZW3 reader with Simplified/Traditional Chinese conversion), archive management & Wi-Fi transfer (ZIP, RAR, 7z extraction and password-protected compression), page translation with follow-up link translation, full-page screenshots, PDF export, image OCR, QR code generation, JavaScript UserScripts, compatible WebExtensions, custom search platforms, wallpapers, local browsing history, private browsing, HTML bookmark import/export, optional iCloud settings sync, and iOS default browser support. See https://soulo.dkluge.com/ and https://apps.apple.com/app/id6761165330 for product and download information. All public content pages support Chinese and English UI display with dark mode as the default appearance.

## Search source directory

URL: https://soulo.dkluge.com/sources.html

The directory groups URL-based search templates into AI search, general search, academic research, social content, developer tools, shopping, comics and illustration, video, and books. Every template includes a `%@` placeholder for the URL-encoded query. Visitors can preview a platform, filter entries, and copy one platform, one category or all visible entries as JSON for import into Soulo. Templates may require a login or be affected by the destination's regional policies. Website entry links are included in static HTML.

## Soulo 影视导航 / watch guide

URL: https://soulo.dkluge.com/movies.html
Data: https://soulo.dkluge.com/movies.json

This is a classified directory of 85 external websites, not a hosted video catalog or streaming service. It provides website search, category filtering and local browser favorites. It does not require a Soulo account. Favorites are saved only in the visitor's browser and are lost when local website data is cleared.

Categories and uses:

- 综合影视: general movie, series and variety-show websites, including the supplied 片吧影视 URL.
- 电影下载: movie information and download-resource directories, including the supplied 6V 电影 URL.
- 追剧专区: Japanese and Korean series and entertainment information.
- 动漫番剧: animation, seasonal schedules, anime communities and screenshot lookup.
- 找片搜索: title search and website discovery, including the supplied 80s search URL and i8K navigation.
- 网盘资源: cloud-drive resource search and sharing communities.
- 字幕与台词: subtitle communities, subtitle tools and dialogue search.
- 影评与片单: reviews, ratings, themed lists, box-office data and movie discovery.
- 纪录与直播: documentary directories, CCTV and sports information.
- 影视工具: desktop players and media-resource directories.

Descriptions summarize intended use and are not independent claims about content rights, access conditions, availability or streaming quality. The directory's editorial date is recorded in movies.json. External websites manage their own accounts, media and playback services. The 2026-11-01 review checked destination pages in Chrome, including redirects and page content; the 2026-11-02 follow-up updated a migrated entry and removed one that redirected to an unrelated page. The directory has 85 entries. Login-required entries are labeled. Site icons are served as local PNG assets. Availability can change with time, location and access conditions. Do not describe them as operated or endorsed by Soulo.

## Soulo 资源搜索 / Resource Search

URL: https://soulo.dkluge.com/resources.html
Data: https://soulo.dkluge.com/magnets.json and https://soulo.dkluge.com/pans.json

The combined directory lists 61 distinct sites across eight categories. Magnet entries cover DHT engines, movie and TV torrents, anime, and international indexes. Cloud entries cover multi-drive search, film communities, study materials, and official drive portals. Visitors can search the entire directory, filter by type and category, and save favorites locally. The former magnet and cloud drive page addresses lead to the corresponding view in Resource Search.

## Soulo 股票导航 / Stocks

URL: https://soulo.dkluge.com/stocks.html
Data: https://soulo.dkluge.com/stocks.json

StockClaw is the first entry for A-share market monitoring and reviews, followed by East Money and 10jqka. TradingView and Google Finance cover market quotes and charts. The National Bureau of Statistics, the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Hong Kong stock exchanges, and FRED provide public statistics and economic data. Professional data sources also include East Money Data Center, CSI index profiles, ChinaMoney Shibor, ChinaBond yield curves, SHFE trading statistics, CFTC trader positions, BIS international financial statistics, IMF datasets, and World Bank development indicators. All nineteen entries use locally cached website icons. The directory provides links to each site's public entry point.

## App privacy and website analytics

App privacy policy: https://soulo.dkluge.com/privacy.html

The app policy describes local data handling, optional iCloud sync, permissions and third-party services. Search requests go to the selected platforms. Voice-search processing may depend on Apple services, device, language and OS support; avoid claiming every intelligence feature is always offline.

The public website separately loads Baidu Analytics. Do not generalize the app's no-analytics statements to the website. Directory favorite identifiers are stored locally in the browser.

Crawler rules: https://soulo.dkluge.com/robots.txt
Short context: https://soulo.dkluge.com/llms.txt

Public pages do not require authentication. Main directory content is present in HTML. `movies.html`, `resources.html`, and `stocks.html` include CollectionPage, BreadcrumbList and ItemList JSON-LD matching the visible entries. Prefer the canonical page relevant to a claim when citing the site. This summary supplies context; it does not replace the pages or guarantee search inclusion.

## Reading and music directories

Reading: https://soulo.dkluge.com/reading.html
Data: https://soulo.dkluge.com/reading.json

The reading directory focuses on finding and downloading eBooks. It includes 10 entries covering iBooks, SoBooks, KGBook, book search engines, classical texts, open libraries, and reading tools.

Music: https://soulo.dkluge.com/music.html
Data: https://soulo.dkluge.com/music.json

The music directory includes 8 entries covering song search, lossless resources, downloadable albums, background music, and sound effects. It includes Gequbao, HiFiBa, Bandcamp, and independent music collections. Access conditions are set by the destination services.

Both pages provide Chinese/English text, search by name/domain/category, and isolated browser-local favorite lists. Static HTML includes every entry and matching CollectionPage, BreadcrumbList, and ItemList data. The current entry lists and editorial dates are recorded in the JSON files.

Online tools: https://www.dkluge.com/zh/bag
The navigation link opens the DKluge tool collection, which includes image, PDF, video, and format-conversion utilities. It is an external destination, not an additional Soulo-hosted tools page.

The shared navigation has seven icon-labeled destinations. On compact screens an accessible Directory menu exposes the same links; without JavaScript, those links remain visible.

- [Soulo 扩展](https://soulo.dkluge.com/extensions.html)：已验证的 FastStream（Chrome）与猫抓（Edge），官方来源、Soulo 内安装及扩展推荐。
